subject: Aligning on demo agenda + dedicated sizing slot
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Park <sarah@horizonpay.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning on demo agenda + dedicated sizing slot

Hi Sarah —

Great to meet you on the call earlier. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps so we can lock the demo + dedicated capacity sizing session:

- Recap: HorizonPay is focused on 1) a low-latency fraud-score endpoint (p95 < 120ms for 512 tokens), 2) throughput for peak windows (target ~4k concurrent inference reqs), and 3) data isolation for EU payments flows.
- Deliverables we promised: short intake worksheet (attached) to capture traffic profile, a demo focused on the inference path, and a separate technical sizing call to map GPUs/quantization to cost targets.

Could you confirm availability for either of these 60–75 minute slots?
  • Option A: Thu Aug 31, 10:00–11:15 PT — demo first, sizing follow-up
  • Option B: Fri Sep 1, 14:00–15:15 PT — combined demo + sizing runbook

If neither works, drop a couple of windows and we’ll adapt. Also, if you can attach a small sample of request QPS/latency during peak (CSV is fine), that will help us pre-load the sizing draft.

Attachment: throughput-intake-worksheet.xlsx (short form)

Thanks — looking forward to locking this.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin

Subject: Re: Aligning on demo agenda + dedicated sizing slot

Thanks Marcus — great talk.

Option B (Fri Sep 1, 14:00–15:15 PT) works best for our infra/ML leads. I'm attaching a short sample of our peak traffic and a CSV of typical payload sizes — should give you the ballpark. A couple quick notes from our side:
- We typically see a burst pattern aligned to settlement windows (10–12 minute bursts every hour) — avg QPS per burst ~3.8k, sustained ~450 QPS outside peaks.
- Payload sizes: median 320 tokens, tail to ~1k tokens.
- Security: we use Okta SSO for developer accounts. Any prerequisites for the demo environment (IP allowlist, SAML config)?

Attachment: horizonpay-traffic-sample.csv

Sarah Park
Head of Platform, HorizonPay
sarah@horizonpay.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

Perfect — thanks for the traffic sample, that's very helpful. Quick answers and what we'll do next: 

- Okta SSO: we support SAML-based SSO for the Redwood Console; for the demo we'll send a temporary demo link unless you'd prefer an SSO test account. If you want SSO, Irene will coordinate the SAML metadata exchange.
- Agenda for Fri Sep 1 (combined demo + sizing):
   1) 10 min intros & success criteria (you + infra lead)
   2) 25 min live demo — inference path and cost/latency tradeoffs
   3) 25–30 min sizing workshop — map your sample QPS to GPU footprints, quantization options, and fallback routing
   4) 10 min next steps & action items (what we’ll send post-call: draft capacity table + mutual action plan)

I've reserved the slot on my calendar tentatively. Please click the scheduling link below to accept; we'll send a calendar invite once confirmed. If you want a separate deeper ops-only sizing session after this, we can book that in the same week.

Scheduling link: https://cal.redwood.ai/marcus/slots-aug29
Drive folder (intake + draft): https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/throughput-intake

Attachment: (none)

—Marcus

Great — we've confirmed Fri Sep 1, 14:00–15:15 PT. Calendar invite and GoToMeeting link will follow; I've added Irene (security lead) and Soojin (inference runtime) to the invite so we can answer SAML and kernel/quantization questions.

Action items for after the call:
- Redwood: send draft capacity table + recommended GPU pool sizes and cost estimate (Marcus + Soojin).
- HorizonPay: share any additional peak-day logs and a list of internal attendees (security/infra) so we can SSO-enable the test environment if needed.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
